test_stash_local_changes_if_needed: test _stash_local_changes_if_needed returns None when git tree is clean and stash ref when local changes exist
test_restore_stashed_changes: test _restore_stashed_changes prompts user before applying stash and restores changes when confirmed
test_restore_stashed_changes_skip: test _restore_stashed_changes skips restore and preserves stash when user declines the prompt
test_restore_stashed_changes_conflicts: test _restore_stashed_changes auto-resets working tree on conflicts without prompting and returns False
test_cmd_update: test cmd_update fetches origin, pulls latest, and installs dependencies with .[all] extras
test_cmd_update_fallback_extras: test cmd_update retries optional extras individually when .[all] install fails
test_cmd_update_ff_only_fallback: test cmd_update falls back to git reset --hard when fast-forward pull fails due to diverged history
test_cmd_update_branch_switch: test cmd_update auto-checks out main branch when currently on a feature branch before pulling
